items.question: Is CoPlay really free?
items.answer: Yes! CoPlay is free to use. We offer a Pro plan for users who want to host larger parties and enjoy an ad-free experience, but the core features will always be free.

items.question: How do shared queues work?
items.answer: Once you start a party, you can share a code with your friends. You can control whether you want others to add, reorder, or remove songs from the queue.

items.question: Do I need to sign up and create an account?
items.answer: Nope! We want to make the experience as easy as possible for you. You can choose to sign up if you want to save your playlists to use across devices or host parties.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
# Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 9, 2026

## 1. Introduction
At CoPlay, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data when you use the CoPlay app and ourservices.

## 2. Data We Collect
CoPlay collects minimal data to provide our services. This may include your email address, name, saved playlists, and saved albums upon optional account creation, and your email address if you choose to join our waitlist.

## 3. Shared Queues and Parties
When you join or host a party, your interactions with the queue (such as adding or removing songs) are visible to other participants in that session. We do not store private listening history beyond the duration of the party session.

## 4. Third-Party Services
CoPlay may integrate with third-party music and video providers, such as YouTube. Your use of these services through CoPlay is also subject to their respective privacy policies. We do not share your personal account credentials with these providers.

## 5. Waitlist Information
For users joining our waitlist, we collect your email address solely to provide updates on app availability and beta testing opportunities. We do not sell or share this information with third parties.

## 6. Data Security
We use industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your data during transit and at rest. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 7. Your Choices
You can manage your data by editing your playlists or deleting your account. You can also unsubscribe from our waitlist communications at any time using the link provided in our emails.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.content:
# Delete Account

If you wish to delete your CoPlay account, you can do so directly within the app.

## Steps to Delete Your Account

1. **Log in** to your CoPlay account.
2. Navigate to the **Library** tab.
3. Click on **Settings** in the top corner.
4. Select the **Delete Account** option from the menu and follow the prompts.

## Data Retention

Upon deleting your account, certain types of data are deleted:
- Music library
- Saved albums
- Search history
